cause_quote: The new `child.execution.outcome === outcome` check invalidated a prepared announcement when an equivalent completion report replaced the outcome object.
user_saw: The main chat could show “This turn ended before a reply: subagent source lifecycle changed before completion delivery” after a subagent reported the same result twice or its queued notification became obsolete.
summary: The fix preserves equivalent subagent outcomes and routes revoked notification delivery through Gateway cancellation.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: existing completion delivery did not depend on outcome object identity, and the registry already replaced outcomes on equivalent reports. PR #149223 made that identity part of the delivery guard, so a duplicate report could newly reject a valid queued announcement. The fix also addresses an older Gateway path that recorded genuine ownership revocation as a failed turn.
